scores.evidence: The dr-table (2 columns) fits at 390 px with no clipping (pages/mobile-jp-03.png, 04). The cycle-flow mermaid is flowchart TD with readable Japanese labels and a clear return edge labelled 直す指摘がある (pages/mobile-jp-17.png). The JSON code blocks ex-settings and setup-settings-model are readable, and their highlights line up (pages/mobile-jp-09.png, 16). metrics.json has no overflow, console, mermaid, unknown-block or image errors.

Every screen has a heading, figure, table, code block or check (textOnlyScreens is empty), and the steps and expect boxes break up the text. But the lesson is long (30 mobile screens), and the header's prerequisites list is an 8-line block of small grey text (pages/mobile-jp-01.png).

All visible text is Japanese, and English terms such as plugin, skill, hook and plan mode appear in parentheses. Glossary terms are underlined, and the key chips and inline code chips stay whole. No line breaks fall inside Japanese words, and contrast is fine except for the small grey prerequisites line.

niceToHave: lesson.prerequisites: the 10 entries show as one 8-line run of small grey text under the title on mobile (pages/mobile-jp-01.png). Shorten them, for example to 第2〜8回・第10回を修了、Gitのcommitの意味がわかる、試せるリポジトリがある.

ex-steps: each step title starts with ① to ⑤, and the reader also draws a numbered circle, so every step shows its number twice (pages/mobile-jp-06.png, pages/desktop-jp-04.png). The circled numbers are what ex-b1 refers to (①と②は初日に…), so either keep them or reword ex-b1 if you drop them.

cycle-steps c-plan: the key chips show as Shift + Tab right next to Ctrl + G with only a small gap, so they can read as one four-key combination (pages/mobile-jp-18.png, pages/desktop-jp-12.png). Consider listing only Shift+Tab in keys and leaving Ctrl + G in the text.

self-check-list sc-safety: on mobile, the plain-text 'git push' breaks across two lines (git / pushの確認…) (pages/mobile-jp-22.png). Writing it as 「git push」 or shortening the label would keep the command together.

ex-settings line 16: the long hook command soft-wraps with a hanging indent on both mobile and desktop (pages/mobile-jp-09.png, pages/desktop-jp-06.png). It is still readable, and the same command appears as an inline chip in ex-steps.
reader: desktop charsPerLine median is 42 against the JP target of 30–40 (measure 680 px).
reader: on mobile-jp-29 a faint blurred shape sits in the top bar next to the title (pages/mobile-jp-29.png).
reader: the end banner says this is the course's last lesson because drafts are not in course.json, and the mobile full-length PNG is capped at 16000 px. These are known preview behaviour.
summary: The screenshots show the lesson under review (lessonHash sha256:3122649e3d005674 from metrics.json), and they have no hard failures, no overflow and no personal data. The vertical cycle diagram, 2-column table, JSON code blocks and prompt blocks are all readable at 390 px. The most useful polish is to shorten the 8-line prerequisites list under the title and remove the double step numbering in ex-steps.
